verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on release notes, changelogs, or version history for skills or plugins. The closest item is codex-plugins-docs-55, which says MCP server changes are picked up and published automatically after checks; that is update propagation, not a changelog a developer can review before taking an update. A plugin and skill marketplace could plausibly ship per-release notes, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update
